Wang is the new song from Ranjit Bawa The hit trio is back together: Ranjit Bawa's powerful voice, Bunty Bains' lyrics and Desi Crew's music, the team behind Akh Mastani, Hype and Graph.
Play it loud and let the Punjabi vibe take over
Song Credits
Singer/Composer Ranjit Bawa
Lyrics/ Composer Bunty Bains
Music/ Composer Desi Crew
Mix/Master Dense
Label - Speed Records
